Name: Joja Entertainment System
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=4][b][color=#ff0000]PREFACE[/color]: These are NOT actual games. Just cute frames.[color=#6d9eeb]

[/color][/b][quote][b][color=#6d9eeb]Joja Entertainment System [/color][/b]- Who says video game skill doesn't translate to real life?[/quote][/size]
[b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart [/color]now sells a gaming system for [u]gaining Skill EXP[/u]![/b]

[b]On the left side of JojaMart [/b]is a bin where you can buy your very own [b][color=#6d9eeb]JES[/color][/b]!

[b][color=#6d9eeb][color=#6d9eeb][b][u]Joja Entertainment System[/u][/b][/color][/color][/b]
   ~Power it up and choose your game. (If you put a seat in front of the TV, up to 4 tiles away, you can sit in it and play!)
   ﻿ ﻿-Each game corresponds to a specific [b]skill[/b]. (Dungeon Delver for combat skill, Forage Frenzy for foraging skill, etc.)[b]
[/b]   ~[b]Click [/b]or [b]press A[/b] to flip through the frames of each game and earn [b]EXP[/b].[b]
[/b]   ﻿~The default gain is [b]0.05 EXP per click while in any of the games.[/b]
   ﻿ ﻿-The EXP amount can be [b]edited in the config[/b].
   ~Play through 30 frames of any game and get a [b]unique +1 buff in that skill[/b] for the rest of the day!
   ~Cute frames and sound effects for each game.
   ~Does not function as a normal TV.

No reason not to continue shopping while at your local JojaMart! Check out: 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry [/url]for canned produce, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37365]JojaSweets Candy[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38012]JojaFizzy Energy Drinks[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBite TV Dinners [/url], or[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38341] JojaFresh Healthy Snacks[/url] for more Joja snacks!

For flexible JojaJobs, try [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38103]JojaFlex - Freelance Contracts[/url]. There's also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39109]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/url] for your fields!
[b]
Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher

Doesn't directly edit the JojaMart map. Should be compatible with mods that edit the store, as long as they don't place anything in the same spot.
Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. (Used in Screenshots. Also in screenshot: Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn + SVE patch, VPR-Inspired UI, Level Progress Viewer)

Downloads.Description:
A small patch for Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn, to have the shop bin inside JojaMart match it's recolor. This is what I'm using in my screenshot.

Install overtop of the main file and say yes to overwriting.
JES - The latest in at-home, All-in-One Entertainment. Gain some skill EXP while you sit and play!
